scope: Actual terminal first failures plus manual RTL source review. Static hazards are explicitly separate from independently isolated simulation results. No candidate edits or rescoring.

trials.confirmed_source_cause: Reset branch does not assign psel or penable; both are only driven in the non-reset executor case statement.
additional_static_findings: Acceptance counts decrement on grant rather than AXI response retirement.
Grant moves state to SETUP but PSEL is assigned in the following SETUP cycle, one cycle after the specified grant edge.
trials.attribution_limit: Only reset failure is confirmed as the first simulated failure; later source hazards are not independently isolated here.

trials.observed_failure: Initial template submitted; no effective edits or public tests
trials.confirmed_source_cause: Five edit replies repeated the tool member in one JSON object; frozen duplicate-key rejection prevented all edits. Model later submitted unchanged initial RTL.
trials.attribution_limit: Terminal template failure is real, but provides no valid measurement of the attempted RTL or of diagnostic feedback use. No rejected edit was recovered or scored as a model submission.

trials.observed_failure: Unretired capacity ledger out of bounds after compile repair
trials.confirmed_source_cause: AW/W/AR counts control READY but decrement on executor grant, not on B/R retirement, allowing more than three unretired requests.
trials.feedback_use: First public compile_error was followed by replacing a typedef used as an estate variable with a declared logic state and localparams. Recompiled successfully, then public capacity failure was delivered. No edit followed the second failure.
additional_static_findings: Two-bit queue pointers increment naturally modulo four despite arrays of three entries.
Separate nonblocking increment/decrement assignments can overwrite simultaneous updates.
trials.attribution_limit: Capacity is the actual first functional test failure; pointer and simultaneous-update hazards were identified in source but not separately isolated.

trials.observed_failure: Unretired capacity ledger out of bounds
trials.confirmed_source_cause: Final AW/W/AR count equations subtract on grant; these counts drive READY, so executed-but-unretired entries no longer reserve capacity.
additional_static_findings: Two-bit pointer increment uses modulo four for arrays of three entries.
do_grant is false in the read-only eligible case and when both directions are eligible with READ preference.
trials.attribution_limit: Capacity is the measured first failure. Read arbitration and pointer hazards are static findings, not independently isolated simulations.
